set.basis: KCC order of May 12, 2026 (Docket 26-EKCE-0148-STG) found the Buffalo Flats - Delaware 345 kV line necessary and approved Evergy's route from Buffalo Flats to US-77 in Cowley County; the segment east of US-77 to the Oklahoma line was denied and is being re-routed. The listing also shows state OK only, but ~133 miles are in Kansas.

NPPD authorized Forbes Bros. Timberline to start R-Project construction from Gerald Gentleman Station toward Stapleton on June 15, 2026 (outside the ABB permit area after the June 8 injunction); NPPD Sept 2026 board update says construction continues on GGS-Stapleton segments; in-service still Sept 2028.

The Nebraska Power Review Board approved the R-Project (PRB-3774) on Oct 10, 2014 and NPPD announced the final route in Jan 2015; the Thedford-Holt County segment is routed and permitted by the state but construction there awaits the federal ABB permit, so it is past 'planned'.
R-Project timeline: substation construction began February 2020; NPPD's 2026 newsletter says it will complete needed substation work in the R-Project area while line work proceeds.
S3454-S3740 is OPPD's Cass-to-Sarpy 345 kV line: construction began Oct 2025; by end of Aug 2026 foundations 96%, structures 84%, wire 60% strung; energization expected Dec 2026.

Monolith's VP said at the July 23, 2026 Hallam town hall that the NPPD substation/switchyard for the Olive Creek expansion has been built; NPPD's Feb 2026 facility study calls the Olive Creek 345/115 kV facilities existing, with breakers 'recently installed'; no exact in-service date published. SPP Q4 2026 QPT shows the Monolith 345 kV substation (and both 345/115 kV transformers) Complete on 2025-12-23.
Basin's PU-24-361 monthly report for August 2026 shows foundations 99% and conductor stringing 61% complete; construction began June 2025, energization targeted Nov-Dec 2026.
Finstad (Basin's Crane Creek) - Tande is part of the single Leland Olds-Crane Creek-Tande 345 kV line under construction since June 2025 (PSC route permit 248, April 2025).
Basin reported on 2026-03-04 that construction began on the Crane Creek 345 kV substation (SPP's 'Finstad'), the new substation on the LOS-Tande line, completion targeted November 2026.
Basin's 2025 recap says the new Leland Olds Station 345 kV substation (nine line terminals) was completed in November 2025. Same source: Leland Olds Station substation completed November 2025.
